notes: Verified against a local postgres:16-alpine (docker, -race -p 1): the 4 new tests plus full internal/sidebar and internal/httpapi packages pass; go vet clean. Pre-fix failure of the new tests is by construction (handler test's before==after check would trip on the first item's committed rename; UpdateMany did not exist).

server/internal/sidebar/service.go UpdateMany: locks rows FOR UPDATE in client-supplied order inside one tx. Two concurrent bulk PUTs by the same user (two tabs dragging) with different orderings can now deadlock; Postgres resolves it and one request answers 500 (api.sidebar.bulk.app_error). Previously per-item txs could not deadlock across items. Only the same user's own rows (user_id/team_id scoped), so no cross-user impact — release note / follow-up, not a defect.

server/internal/httpapi/compat_wave_handlers_early.go getSidebarCategory: 500 responses keep the error id api.sidebar.get.not_found and echo err.Error() (DB error text) to the client. Both are pre-existing writeSidebarError behaviour, intentionally kept for client matching; not new to this PR.

Duplicate ids in one array: every response element is re-read after commit, so both elements show the final state (previously out[0] showed the intermediate value). Final stored state is unchanged; harmless.
gofmt import-order diff in sidebar/service.go and httpapi/native_activity.go pre-exists on main and is not introduced here.
getSidebarCategory 404/500 split is a small scope addition beyond the bulk-tx fix but is declared in the commit body and covered by its own test.
